Scheduling is the process of planning, organizing, and deciding when and in what order tasks, activities, events, or the use of resources (like staff, machines, or time) will happen.

Memory allocation is the process of setting aside or assigning computer memory (RAM or virtual memory) to a software program, application, or process so it can store data and execute tasks.

Logging has two main meanings in English, depending on whether you are talking about forestry or computers/data.
